title: Broad `except Exception` in cross-cell query loop logs but loses exception type
detail: Line 281 catches `Exception` broadly when querying instances from a cell, logs a warning, and continues to the next cell. The broad catch masks unexpected programming errors (e.g. `AttributeError`) that would look identical to a genuine cell connectivity failure. Suggested fix: narrow to the specific RPC/network exceptions the cell client can raise; let unexpected exceptions propagate.
